item: Day counts differ from the pre-freeze estimate
detail: The pre-freeze estimate dropped days with a missing India VIX value; the built panel keeps them and carries VIX forward, as decided. Features are first available on 2010-01-18, one day before the frozen training start of 2010-01-19, which stands. Training window 2010-01-19 to 2014-12-31 has 1220 days (as estimated). Out-of-sample window 2015-01-01 to 2026-10-30 has 2920 days (estimate was 2900). No frozen setting changes: settings.toml fixes dates, not day counts.

The pre-freeze figure of 17 counted NIFTY 50 index trading days with no VIX value. The build counts days on the ETF calendar (both ETFs have a close), which has 4 extra days on which the index series also has no row: 2009-10-13, 2019-10-27, 2020-11-14 and 2026-01-15. 17 + 4 = 21. All 21 gaps are a single trading day; none is consecutive with another. The value carried forward is at most 3 calendar days old. By year: 2009: 1, 2019: 1, 2020: 2, 2021: 10, 2022: 1, 2024: 2, 2025: 2, 2026: 2.
outcome: Longest gap 1 trading day; limit of 5 never reached

detail: Forward filter: 5 known-answer tests (hand calculation; uninformative data; agreement with hmmlearn on likelihood and last-day probabilities with earlier days differing; extreme observation; truncation). Look-ahead harness: passes a trailing mean; fails a centred mean, a one-day back-shift and full-sample standardisation, as it must. Real pipeline: features causal at 4 cuts; hmmlearn smoothed probabilities caught as leaking (negative control); plain-HMM walk-forward signals unchanged at 5 cuts (day before a refit, refit day, day after, mid-block, sixth block). Signals were compared for equality only; no performance was computed.

Timing run of state selection on 2010-01-19 to 2014-12-31: held-out log-likelihood on the last 20% of the window was -1298.9 (2 states), -1039.7 (3) and -979.0 (4); 4 states chosen, the top of the frozen grid. Settings unchanged.
